title: Known-object test, TOI-588.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-588.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, 3, ≤2.5, 6, ≤2.5, ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 0.2%, 0.2%, 0.5%, 0.5%, 0.5%, 0.5% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 100%, 100%, 60%, 60%, 80%, 80%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 675 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 314 distinct event(s), 7 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
